thesis: The podcast argues that while AI agents require centralized data context, established incumbents like SAP are reacting with extreme API restrictions that may be unnecessary. The discussion highlights the industry shift from building data infrastructure for business intelligence to building it specifically for AI agents, noting that the primary challenge is now ensuring systems access the right context at the right time rather than just collecting data.
